z1-setzero-skips-hidden.edit: setZero selects categories with the average actions' query (hidden categories and hidden groups skipped)

z1-excluded-await-6-12.edit: set6MonthAvg / set12MonthAvg await setNMonthAvg per category, as set3MonthAvg awaits its averages

z1-excluded-missing-group.edit: the average actions keep a category whose group row is missing (COALESCE(g.hidden, 0) = 0), as copyPreviousMonth does
